resources.title: Holy Paladin Mythic+ and Raid Guide — Midnight Season 1

resources.title: How to Play BLOOD DEATH KNIGHT in Midnight!
resources.creator: WoW at Night
resources.noteEs: Guía completa de Blood Death Knight para Midnight: el tank más self-sufficient del juego, con healing propio y survivability tooling distinto al resto. WoW at Night cubre talents, rotation defensiva, kiting y cuándo usar cada cooldown major. Útil para tanks experimentados que llegan a DK desde otra spec, y para mains DK que están refrescando post-patch.
resources.noteEn: Complete Blood Death Knight guide for Midnight: the most self-sufficient tank in the game, with own-healing and survivability tooling unlike the rest. WoW at Night covers talents, defensive rotation, kiting, and when to use each major cooldown. Useful for experienced tanks coming from another spec, and for DK mains refreshing post-patch.

resources.title: 12.0.5 Frost Mage Guide Midnight | ST & AOE Rotation, Basics, Gear
resources.creator: Schabl3n
resources.noteEs: Frost Mage es la spec ranged DPS más popular para players que recién aprenden raiding o Mythic+, gracias a rotación predecible y kit de utility (control, mobility, AoE strong). Schabl3n cubre lo esencial del patch 12.0.5 — basics, single-target rotation, AoE, gear priority — en formato denso y compacto.
resources.noteEn: Frost Mage is the most popular ranged DPS spec for players just learning raiding or Mythic+, thanks to predictable rotation and utility kit (control, mobility, strong AoE). Schabl3n covers what's essential in patch 12.0.5 — basics, single-target rotation, AoE, gear priority — in a dense and compact format.
